headline: Wardens Recover Stlican Shelf Works as Callahan's Passage Cools
war_summary: The balance on Stlican Shelf has turned since our last edition: where the Colonials then held four works and two lay in ruin, the Wardens now count six of the shelf's nine strongpoints and not one stands demolished. The fighting is as fierce as ever — ten base actions in two hours, forty-four in a day, with The Pale House, Vulpine Watch, and The Old Mourn bearing the brunt, the latest blow struck minutes before this edition closed. Callahan's Passage, late the war's busiest slaughterhouse, shows Wardens in possession of all ten works, its toll easing to some 360 a side in two hours. Weathered Expanse refuses to settle: no base action in four hours, yet Spirit Watch — twenty events in a day — and casualties accelerating sharply in the latest hour tell of unresolved struggle. The Dead Lands is quiet on the map but not in the ledger, near 18,400 casualties in a day. Stonecradle stirs anew; Fisherman's Row and Marban Hollow have quieted. On our count the Colonials hold 264 strategic works, the Wardens 172, none in ruin. It is the 161st day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
